faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, net banking, UPI, wallets, and select buy-now-pay-later options. Available methods may vary by location and order value.

faqs.question: Is it safe to make payments on the platform?
faqs.answer: Yes, all payments are processed through secure and encrypted payment gateways. We do not store your card details on our servers.

faqs.question: Why did my payment fail but the amount got debited?
faqs.answer: In rare cases, banks may debit the amount even if the transaction fails. The debited amount is usually refunded automatically within 5–7 business days.

faqs.question: Can I use Cash on Delivery?
faqs.answer: Cash on Delivery is available on select products and locations. Eligibility depends on your delivery address and order value.

faqs.question: What are the delivery timelines?
faqs.answer: Delivery timelines vary based on your location, seller, and product availability. Estimated delivery dates are shown during checkout.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order is shipped, you can track it from the 'My Orders' section using the tracking link provided.

faqs.question: Do you offer same-day or express delivery?
faqs.answer: Same-day or express delivery is available in select cities for eligible products. Options will be shown at checkout if applicable.

faqs.question: What happens if I am not available at the time of delivery?
faqs.answer: Our delivery partner will attempt re-delivery. If delivery fails multiple times, the order may be returned to the seller.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Most products can be returned within the specified return window, provided they are unused and in original packaging. Return eligibility varies by product.

faqs.question: How do I initiate a return?
faqs.answer: You can initiate a return from the 'My Orders' section by selecting the item and choosing the return option.

faqs.question: Are there any products that cannot be returned?
faqs.answer: Certain items like personal care products, innerwear, and customized items may not be eligible for return due to hygiene or customization reasons.

faqs.question: When will I receive my refund?
faqs.answer: Refunds are initiated after the returned item passes quality checks. The amount is typically credited within 5–10 business days.

faqs.question: Will I get a full refund?
faqs.answer: You will receive a full refund if the return meets policy conditions. Shipping or convenience fees may be non-refundable in some cases.

faqs.question: How will the refund be processed?
faqs.answer: Refunds are processed to the original payment method used during purchase. For Cash on Delivery orders, refunds may be issued to your bank account or wallet.

faqs.question: Are the products genuine?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ensure that all products sold on our platform are genuine and sourced from verified sellers.

faqs.question: What should I do if I receive a damaged or defective product?
faqs.answer: If you receive a damaged or defective item, please raise a return or replacement request within the specified time window from the 'My Orders' section.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. Once shipped, cancellation may not be possible.

faqs.question: Can I modify my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Order modifications are not supported after confirmation. You may cancel the order and place a new one if needed.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to place an order?
faqs.answer: Yes, an account is required to place orders so you can track purchases, manage returns, and receive updates.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
faqs.answer: You can reset your password using the 'Forgot Password' option on the login page.

faqs.question: How do I apply a coupon code?
faqs.answer: Coupon codes can be applied at checkout in the designated coupon section before making the payment.

faqs.question: Why is my coupon not working?
faqs.answer: Coupons may have usage limits, expiry dates, or product restrictions. Please check the terms and conditions of the offer.

faqs.question: How is my personal data used?
faqs.answer: Your personal data is used only to process orders, provide customer support, and improve your shopping experience, as per our privacy policy.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: You can reach customer support through the Help section on the app or website via chat, email, or call.

faqs.question: What are your customer support working hours?
faqs.answer: Customer support is available 24x7, although response times may vary during peak hours.
